The inputs that usually separate two numbers — the confirmed eleven, fresh injury and fitness news, weather at the venue — haven't landed yet, so today there's nothing pulling the prior away from the price. The engine refreshes as kickoff nears; if news moves enough of the prior, this can turn into a Pick. Until then, there's no gap to show.
